result.topic_en: A relation expressing the hypergeometric-type function P(α,δ,γ,1−x) times a cosine as a combination of parameter derivatives of other P-functions plus a logarithmic term, written at the foot of an otherwise nearly blank page, with a remark on how the integration constants are determined.
result.transcription:
$\delta = \alpha - \gamma - 1$ [-...-]
$\partial\delta = -\partial\alpha$
$P(\alpha,\delta,\gamma,1-x)\cos m\pi\cdot\pi = +\frac{\partial P(\delta,\gamma,\beta,x)}{\partial\delta}\sin\gamma\pi + \frac{\partial P(\alpha,\beta,\gamma,x)}{\partial\alpha}\sin\beta\pi$
$+ \log x\, \Sigma^{m} P(\delta,\gamma,\beta,x)\sin\gamma\pi$
Die {+Integralconstanten[?]+} [-Coefficienten[?]-] sind nach [-f-] steigenden Potenzen von $x$ unmittelbar[?]
daß [-...-] daraus[?] man leichter[?] zum Ziel kommen[?] muß[?] von den Reihen[?]
aus geht.

methods.what: Expression of a P-function at 1−x (degenerate/logarithmic case) as combination of parameter derivatives of P-functions at x plus a logarithmic term
Parameter substitution linking δ and α
Determining the integration constants by comparing ascending powers of x in the series
